Rule.Name: Single Security Concentration Limit
Rule.Description: No single equity position shall exceed 10% of total portfolio market value

Rule.Name: Sector Concentration Limit
Rule.Description: No single sector shall exceed 30% of total portfolio market value

Rule.Name: Fixed Income Minimum Allocation
Rule.Description: Fixed income allocation shall not fall below 15% for retirement and pension accounts

Rule.Name: Trade Settlement Monitoring
Rule.Description: All trades must settle within T+2 business days

Rule.Name: Position Reconciliation Tolerance
Rule.Description: Internal positions must match custodian positions within 0.01% tolerance

Rule.Name: Cash Buffer Requirement
Rule.Description: Each account must maintain minimum 2% cash buffer
